description.value: Tom Sushi is a premium Japanese restaurant on Davie Street in the heart of downtown Vancouver, founded in 2019 by Chef Tom Jeon, who brings over a decade of sushi expertise to a menu that blends traditional Japanese flavours with Pacific Northwest ingredients. The restaurant has been recognized by Yelp as the second-best rated restaurant in Canada. Its understated, elegant interior is designed for a relaxed dining experience, and an online ordering system is also available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates OSM contact details (address, phone, email) and confirms the business is open and operating. The plastic-bag-charge notice on the website implies takeout is available, and the OSM tag diet:vegetarian=yes is supplementary evidence for vegetarian options (not explicitly confirmed on the website). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill appears on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant in downtown Vancouver with a recently verified OSM record (check_date 2026-05-05) and active website. A clear option for touring cyclists seeking a meal on Davie Street.
